title: The focused pane is outlined in cyan
body:
The focused pane's outline is `ACCENT` (`FOCUS` in `src/server/panes.rs`), and pane drop zones during a drag are `CYAN` (`DROP`). Jack wants the focus outline in cyan.

## Proposal

`FOCUS` becomes `CYAN`, and `DROP` becomes `ACCENT`, so a drop zone does not look like a focused pane. Anything else that marks the focused pane in `ACCENT` follows to `CYAN`. The sidebar's branch names stay `CYAN`, since they are text and not outlines.
